title: Case #1 — MIGHTEE deep field (MeerKAT)
description: MIGHTEE COSMOS field, 4 h with MeerKAT (64 x 13.5 m) at L band: 1284 MHz centre, 856 MHz in 64 channels of 13.375 MHz, 8 s integrations. Sky: 487 MIGHTEE DR1 COSMOS components (Hale et al. 2025) with their deconvolved sizes, plus 9632 T-RECS sources (Bonaldi et al. 2019) below the MIGHTEE completeness limit, trimmed to the 0.2 deg image (10119 components, flat spectrum). Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (426 Jy, eta_c 0.98), no RFI flagging. Natural-weight thermal rms 1.38 uJy/beam. WSClean multiscale, Briggs robust -1, 1024 x 1024 px at 0.703 arcsec (0.2 deg), 8 output channels joined, 100000 iterations, mgain 0.8, auto-threshold 0.3, auto-mask 3; plus an OSKAR dirty image.
